assets.name: The Cooperative Crown
assets.thesis: A central assembly rotunda and four equal wings turn shared ownership into the organizing geometry.
assets.businessCue: Retailer-owned cooperative supported by shared infrastructure.

assets.name: The Toolwright Capitol
assets.thesis: A stepped hall, workshop wings, and open gantry monumentalize disciplined tool organization.
assets.businessCue: Professional tools and practical workshop expertise.

assets.name: The Neighborhood Exchange
assets.thesis: A covered civic exchange makes local service and community access the dominant idea.
assets.businessCue: Locally owned neighborhood stores and helpful service.

assets.name: The Repair Foundry
assets.thesis: A tall training tower and connected repair halls frame fixing things as a civic discipline.
assets.businessCue: Repair, maintenance, making, and practical expertise.

assets.name: The Timber Truss Hall
assets.thesis: A long stepped nave and explicit truss system celebrate construction knowledge and materials.
assets.businessCue: Building materials, lumber, and construction guidance.

assets.name: The Finish Lantern
assets.thesis: Nested shells and precise surface layers reinterpret coatings and finish expertise without literal imagery.
assets.businessCue: Paint, coatings, material finish, and careful application.

assets.name: The Fastener Bastion
assets.thesis: Interlocked hexagonal terraces express connection, reliability, and structural permanence.
assets.businessCue: Fasteners, joints, dependable connection, and mechanical fit.

assets.name: The Garden Hearth Commons
assets.thesis: A central hearth tower and open-lattice commons combine shelter, stewardship, and gathering.
assets.businessCue: Home care, outdoor living, garden stewardship, and neighborhood gathering.

assets.name: The Supply Nexus
assets.thesis: A central dispatch hall and four connected supply wings make cooperative logistics visible.
assets.businessCue: Shared distribution supporting many independently owned stores.

assets.name: The Service Arch
assets.thesis: An inhabitable arch and generous public passage turn helpful service into spatial openness.
assets.businessCue: Accessible expertise, practical help, and a protected meeting place.
